description: This file defines the 'Permission' entity class used for managing permissions within the application, including fields for permission name, associated groups, and audit information.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Entity class representing a permission that can be associated with groups, including audit info and persistence annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the permission.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the permission.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the permission.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of groups associated with this permission.

methods.name: setGroups
methods.description: Sets the list of groups associated with this permission.
